tenders.title: BIM Consultancy Services for Architectural, Structural, and MEP services for CPWD projects
tenders.scope_summary: The tender is for comprehensive BIM consultancy services for architectural, structural, and MEP services, including BIM modeling of minimum LOD 350, clash detection, and preparation of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) for various buildings. The BIM model will be used for design, coordination, and integration of plumbing, sanitary, electrical, firefighting, fire alarm, HVAC, and low voltage systems, as well as horticulture and landscaping design.
key_points: BIM modeling at minimum LOD 350 for architectural, structural, and MEP services.
Integration and coordination of various building services including plumbing, electrical, and HVAC.
Preparation and submission of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
Consultancy charges are inclusive of BIM model development and WBS.
Clash detection is a key deliverable.

tenders.title: Supply of Terrestrial Laser Scanner
tenders.tendering_authority: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)
tenders.scope_summary: This tender invites sealed quotations for the supply of a Terrestrial Laser Scanner with specific technical requirements including the ability to generate contours from point cloud data, cross-section generation, volume computation, and noise removal. The software should also be capable of controlling the scanner and performing global registration.
key_points: Supply of one Terrestrial Laser Scanner as per Annexure-I specifications.
Software capable of generating contours from point cloud, cross-sections, and volume computation.
Software features for data noise removal and global registration.
Quotation valid for 120 days from tender opening.
Training charges should be clearly indicated.

tenders.title: Tender for Non-Contact 3D Optical Profilometer for Optics Surface Form/Shape Measurement
tenders.scope_summary: This is a two-part e-tender for the supply of a non-contact 3D optical profilometer. Key technical requirements include the ability to export 3D point cloud data in various formats and provision for data analysis. Bidders are advised not to mention prices in the technical bid.
key_points: Supply of Non-Contact 3D Optical Profilometer.
System must support 3D point cloud data export in formats like XYZ/DAT, SUR, ASCII, binary.
Data analysis provision is required.
Two-part tender: technical and price bids are separate.
Bid submission due date is October 8, 2026.

tenders.title: AI BASED SNAG RECTIFICATION AND PREDICTIVE MAINTENANCE BASED ON GROUND AND FLIGHT DATA SYSTEM - EOI
tenders.scope_summary: Expression of Interest (EOI) for an AI-based system for snag rectification and predictive maintenance using ground and flight data.
key_points: AI-based snag rectification system.
Predictive maintenance based on ground and flight data.
Quantity: 1 system.
Tender closing date: October 3, 2026.
Located in Karnataka, India.
